metadata.scenario: A patient calls upset because the aide arrived an hour late today and didn't apologize. The patient had to wait and missed taking her morning medication on time. She wants to make sure this doesn't happen again.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Mary O'Connor, and I'm really upset about something that happened today. I'm sorry to hear that, Mary. Can you tell me what happened? The aide was an hour late arriving this morning, and she didn't even apologize. I missed my morning medication because of it! That sounds very frustrating, and I completely understand your concern. Yes, it’s really stressful for me, especially since I have to stick to my medication schedule closely. I absolutely understand. Your health is our top priority. Let me note this down and address it right away. I hope this doesn’t happen again. I need caregivers who are reliable and can reassure me. I completely agree, and I’ll make sure to discuss this with the team. Can I get the name of the aide who arrived late? It was Sarah, I believe. She’s usually nice, but this was just really disappointing. Thank you for that information, Mary. I’ll follow up with Sarah to ensure she understands the importance of timely visits. I just want to make sure this doesn’t happen again. It really affects my anxiety levels. I understand completely. We want to ensure you feel comfortable and cared for. Is there anything else you can do to make it better? I can arrange for a skilled nurse to visit regularly for medication management. Would that help? That sounds good, but how much would that cost? Our skilled nursing care is priced between $95 and $125 for a 1-2 hour visit. Okay, let me think about that. I’m just really worried about my health. Of course, Mary. Your health and peace of mind are important. I’ll follow up on Sarah’s tardiness and the nurse option. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate you listening to my concerns. You’re welcome, Mary. I’ll make sure to keep you informed about the actions we take. Okay, I’ll look forward to hearing back from you. Absolutely. Have a good day, and take care. You too, bye. Goodbye!
